svg.title: Pathway Clock vs. Calendar
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-pathway-clock-vs-calendar; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Pathway Clock vs. Calendar; subtitle: FDA review-clock targets against elapsed days in practice; caption: leanRAQA's pathway table shows the FDA clock understating real elapsed time on every route, with the 510(k) at a 90-day clock but about 200 days in practice.; assumptions note: Elapsed-day values are approximate figures from the leanRAQA pathway table; the PMA 180-day clock is cited in the conversion text rather than plotted as its own stage.; note: Attributed to leanRAQA, with hold-letter and fee guidance from Prime Path Medtech and Registrar Corp.; stages: label: PMA elapsed in practice; value: 800; display: ~800 days; conversion: vs 180-day FDA clock; detail: leanRAQA puts PMA at about 800 actual days; only PMA devices are 'approved.'; label: De Novo elapsed in practice; value: 400; display: ~400 days; conversion: vs 120-day FDA clock; detail: leanRAQA warns that words like 'novel' push a predicate comparison toward De Novo.; label: 510(k) elapsed in practice; value: 200; display: ~200 days; conversion: vs 90-day FDA clock; detail: The 510(k) is the dominant route; Registrar Corp quotes a $24,335 standard FY2025 fee.; label: De Novo on the FDA clock; value: 120; display: 120 days; conversion: Clock target; ~400 days actual; detail: Lock the exact three-letter product code before filing to avoid an RTA refusal.; label: 510(k) on the FDA clock; value: 90; display: 90 days; conversion: Clock target; ~200 days actual; detail: Prime Path Medtech: an unpaid user fee triggers a hold letter before review starts.

rect.title: label: PMA elapsed in practice; value: 800; display: ~800 days; conversion: vs 180-day FDA clock; detail: leanRAQA puts PMA at about 800 actual days; only PMA devices are 'approved.'
label: De Novo elapsed in practice; value: 400; display: ~400 days; conversion: vs 120-day FDA clock; detail: leanRAQA warns that words like 'novel' push a predicate comparison toward De Novo.
label: 510(k) elapsed in practice; value: 200; display: ~200 days; conversion: vs 90-day FDA clock; detail: The 510(k) is the dominant route; Registrar Corp quotes a $24,335 standard FY2025 fee.
label: De Novo on the FDA clock; value: 120; display: 120 days; conversion: Clock target; ~400 days actual; detail: Lock the exact three-letter product code before filing to avoid an RTA refusal.

text.title: De Novo on the FDA clock: 120
text.tspan: De Novo on the FDA clock: 120

rect.title: label: 510(k) on the FDA clock; value: 90; display: 90 days; conversion: Clock target; ~200 days actual; detail: Prime Path Medtech: an unpaid user fee triggers a hold letter before review starts.

text.title: Assumptions: Elapsed-day values are approximate figures from the leanRAQA pathway table; the PMA 180-day clock is cited in the conversion text rather than plotted as its own stage.

conversion text rather than plotted as its own stage.
